title: Improve UI-interaction to change viewrange on overview (feature request)
body:
**Improve UI-interaction to change view range on overview (feature request):**

**Proposed solution options**
I can think of several ways to make changing the view more user friendly:
1. UI option on overview (popup/dropdown?) to directly select on of the 4 possible view ranges.
2. Single UI action for the user to go back to a configurable default view range .
3. UI automatically switching to user configurable default after NN minutes?

(Personally I would prefer option 1)

**Reason:**
As changing the view range obviously takes time it can never be very responsive. Mostly because of this I have grown to dislike the UI interaction method to change the view range (tab-hold-and-wait for rendering).
As is now I often find myself hunting for the desired view range: tab-hold-wait, tab-hold-wait, Oops... one to many?
Go round again: tap-hold-etc.... Quite tedious sometimes!
